device.description: 8-bit 4-channel 50-200 kSPS SAR ADC with SPI-compatible serial interface
device.note: adc084s021.pdf (SNAS279F) p.3 pin configuration and functions, p.4 recommended operating conditions, p.6 output coding and AC characteristics, p.7 timing requirements, p.8 Figures 1 and 3, p.16-19 serial interface, Tables 1-3

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: internal control register loaded from DIN on the first 8 rising SCLK edges of each conversion; no read-back. Reset 0 = IN1 (the first conversion after power up is of IN1)

commands.name: Control register (DIN, 8 rising edges) + 8 don't-care clocks
commands.note: Tables: bits 7-6 and 2-0 DONTC, ADD2-ADD0 in bits 5-3; ADD2 x, ADD1-ADD0 = 00 IN1, 01 IN2, 10 IN3, 11 IN4; selects the channel of the next conversion

pages: p.3 pin configuration and functions; p.4 recommended operating conditions (VA 2.7-5.25 V, digital inputs -0.3 V to VA); p.6 output coding and AC characteristics (straight binary, tCONV 13 SCLK, throughput 16 SCLK); p.7 timing requirements (tEN 30, tACC 30, tDIS 20 ns max); p.8 Figures 1 and 3 (frame: Z3-Z0 zeros, DB7-DB0, 4 zeros; DIN DONTC DONTC ADD2 ADD1 ADD0 DONTC DONTC DONTC); p.16-19 serial interface, Tables 1-3 (control register, channel selection, multiple conversions per frame)
notModeled: analog inputs and multiplexer (every conversion returns the 0 V code 0x00); the channel field is stored only
the conversion is clocked by SCLK (3 track + 13 conversion clocks); not timed, the result is the 0 V code at once
the control word selects the channel of the NEXT conversion (pipelined); with a constant 0 V code this has no visible effect

SPI mode 3 chosen: Figure 4 shows SCLK idling high, DOUT changing on falling edges, DIN sampled on rising edges; the datasheet allows SCLK high or low at CS fall (tCSU/tCLH), and with SCLK low at CS fall the internal SCLK sees CS fall as the first falling edge
several conversions per frame (each frame an integer multiple of 16 SCLKs): modeled by the 16-bit stream command and idle "repeat"; the track/hold re-entry timing is not modeled
power-down while CS is high and between continuous conversions (no digital effect)
SCLK frequency limits (0.8-3.2 MHz specified; 50 kHz-16 MHz functional), tCSU/tCLH, tACQ and throughput
tEN/tACC 30 ns are the maxima; typical values are lower at 5 V
variants: ADC084S021 / ADC084S051 / ADC084S101 are the same pinout and frame at different sample-rate ranges (separate datasheets); ADC104S/ADC124S are the 10/12-bit parts
